card.name: Partway through rare long words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of rare or long words, such as Lao script syllables and drug names split into parts (donepez-il, sofos-buvir, Meropen-em). Also error codes and Malay word endings.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle or end piece of a long drug or lab term split into parts.

modes.label: Lao script syllables
modes.description: Single syllable pieces within Lao-language text.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Pieces of error codes or Malay words.
modes.example: E<<INTR>> The call was interrupted by a signal.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of unusual long words, mostly drug names, and in Lao script, as the word is still being spelled out.
